Messages.Body:
In article <HVj96.11351$jk6.3...@typhoon2.ba-dsg.net>,

Wilbert Bishop <wi...@bellatlantic.net> wrote:
>ok..when you play the card at superior, does the minion tap before it can be
>block?????

No. Like any other card, the card text applies when the action resolves, and
not before (barring 'do not replace' text, of course). The minion is tapped
when (and if) the action resolves (is unblocked).

>and how does it play???

Like any other action. Did you have a specific question, or are you unclear
on how to play actions in general?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
go...@best.com (Gomi no Sensei) wrote:
> Wilbert Bishop <wi...@bellatlantic.net> wrote:

> >ok..when you play the card [Propaganda] at superior, does the
> >minion tap before [the action] can be [blocked]?
>
> No. Like any other [action] card, the card text applies when the

> action resolves, and not before (barring 'do not replace' text, of
> course). The minion is tapped when (and if) the action resolves (is
> unblocked).

Correct.
BTW, the "Do Not Replace" is a specific case - inherent stealth
(Atonement, e.g.) and general requirements (Monomancy, e.g.) also
apply, naturally enough, before the action resolves. You can
identify this type of text because it is bold and at the start
of the text area.

> >and how does it play???

You play the card and tap the acting minion and announce the action.
If the action is successul, you apply the results: your prey (or
whomever the action got bounced to) burns a pool and taps one of
his or her ready untapped minions.
